import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Convert is_fraud to categorical variable for visualization
credit_fraud['is_fraud'] = credit_fraud['is_fraud'].astype('category')

# Create a bar chart to compare the distribution of transaction types
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=credit_fraud)
ax.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Types by Fraud Status')
ax.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax.set_ylabel('Count')
ax.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
